production_order_export_coerent.name: production_order_export_coerent
production_order_export_coerent.value:
("production_order"."status" = 'exportat' and "production_order"."export_id" is not null)
          or ("production_order"."status" <> 'exportat' and "production_order"."export_id" is null)

recipe_line_variabil_coerent.name: recipe_line_variabil_coerent
recipe_line_variabil_coerent.value:
("recipe_line"."este_variabil" = true and "recipe_line"."cod_saga" is null and "recipe_line"."categorie_variabila" is not null)
          or ("recipe_line"."este_variabil" = false and "recipe_line"."cod_saga" is not null)

recipe_line_mod_coerent.name: recipe_line_mod_coerent
recipe_line_mod_coerent.value:
("recipe_line"."mod_calcul" = 'fixa' and "recipe_line"."cantitate_fixa" is not null)
          or ("recipe_line"."mod_calcul" = 'formula' and "recipe_line"."formula" is not null and length(btrim("recipe_line"."formula")) > 0)
          or "recipe_line"."mod_calcul" = 'tabel'

recipe_line_dimension_override_motivat.name: recipe_line_dimension_override_motivat
recipe_line_dimension_override_motivat.value:
"recipe_line_dimension"."este_override" = false
          or ("recipe_line_dimension"."motiv" is not null and length(btrim("recipe_line_dimension"."motiv")) > 0 and "recipe_line_dimension"."setat_de" is not null and "recipe_line_dimension"."setat_la" is not null)

unmapped_material_rezolvat_coerent.name: unmapped_material_rezolvat_coerent
unmapped_material_rezolvat_coerent.value: ("unmapped_material"."rezolvat" = false and "unmapped_material"."rezolvat_la" is null) or ("unmapped_material"."rezolvat" = true and "unmapped_material"."rezolvat_la" is not null)
